        cui_month_result r = cui_month_calendar_ex(ui, "fixed_id", &p_month, (const cui_month_event *)rec_events->items, rec_events->count, &o);
        (void)r;
        if (memcmp(&p_month, &p_month_was, sizeof p_month) != 0) { cuisv_record_write(s, 3, -1, &cuisv_sd_cui_date, &p_month); }
    }
}
